name: Is there a file size limit for merging PDFs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, one: the files in a single merge can add up to 500 MB in Chrome or Edge on a computer with 8 GB+ memory, or 300 MB on phones, Safari and Firefox. There is no paywall, no daily cap and no file-count limit — PDFree processes files locally in your browser, so the ceiling protects your device's memory rather than selling an upgrade. Bigger jobs? Merge in two steps.

name: Does PDFree store or log my files after processing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree runs entirely in your browser — there is no backend server that receives your files. Because nothing is uploaded, nothing can be stored, logged, or retained. Your document exists only in your browser's memory for the duration of the session and is cleared when you close the tab.
Yes. PDFree is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Once loaded, it works fully offline — no internet connection required for processing.

name: How many PDF files can I merge at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: As many as you like — there is no file-count limit and no daily limit, so you can merge 2, 50, or 100+ files in one go. The files in a single merge can add up to 500 MB on a computer (Chrome/Edge, 8 GB+ RAM) or 300 MB on phones. Everything runs in your browser's memory, so very large batches are faster on a computer than on an older phone — close other tabs if it struggles.

name: Will the formatting and fonts be preserved after merging?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree uses pdf-lib, which copies pages at the PDF object level — fonts, images, vector graphics, and formatting are preserved exactly as in the originals. This includes each page's own size and orientation: if you merge a mix of portrait and landscape pages, or different paper sizes, each page keeps its original dimensions in the merged file instead of being stretched or shrunk to match the others.
No. Encrypted PDFs cannot be read or modified without the password. Remove the password first using a PDF tool, then merge.

name: Is there a daily limit on how many merges I can do?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree has no daily usage cap. Merge as many PDFs as you want, as often as you need — no task limits, no file count limits.

name: Does merging upload my files to a server?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree merges PDF files entirely in your browser using pdf-lib. Your files never leave your device and are never sent to any server.

name: Can I merge PDFs on a phone or tablet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree works in mobile browsers — Chrome for Android and Safari for iOS. File selection uses the native file picker, and you can reorder files using the on-screen buttons.

name: Are bookmarks and hyperlinks preserved when I merge PDFs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Links are preserved, including links that point to a specific page — even across files, they're correctly remapped to the merged document. Each source file's own pre-existing bookmarks don't carry over automatically, but turning on "Create bookmarks" before merging adds a fresh bookmark for every file, named after it, so you can jump straight to where each original document starts inside the combined PDF — visible in your PDF reader's Bookmarks or Table of Contents panel.

name: Can I insert a blank page between each merged file?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Turn on "Insert blank pages" and choose Always (a blank page after every file except the last) or On odd page count (only when a file's own page count is odd). This is mainly useful for double-sided printing — each original document starts on a fresh sheet instead of partway through the previous one.
